episode_title: Interview with Rhea Cruz-Magpantay of 1Heart Caregiver Services in Pasadena, California

real_qa.q: When did Rhea Cruz-Magpantay sign up for her 1Heart Caregiver Services franchise in Pasadena, California?
real_qa.r: Rhea signed up for her 1Heart franchise on September 23rd, 2022. She and her brother started the business together in the Pasadena market and have been operating for approximately four years as of the interview date.
real_qa.requete: 1Heart Caregiver Services Pasadena franchise start date

real_qa.q: How did Rhea Cruz-Magpantay discover 1Heart Caregiver Services and decide to join the franchise?
real_qa.r: Rhea discovered 1Heart through a serendipitous connection on Facebook while searching LA Jobs, a placement company founded by Belina. When she visited the LA Jobs office, she found it had a large logo of 1Heart on the wall. The LA Jobs coordinator was Bernadette, who turned out to be the mother of Rhea's high school friend and encouraged her to speak with Belina about the franchise opportunity, leading to her decision to join 1Heart.
real_qa.requete: how Rhea Cruz-Magpantay found 1Heart Caregiver Services

real_qa.q: How many caregivers does 1Heart Caregiver Services in Pasadena currently employ, and what is the client roster size?
real_qa.r: Rhea manages approximately 45 to 50 caregivers on every two-week payroll, including four office workers, with the remaining being direct caregivers. She maintains about 30 active regular clients, plus additional staffing through contracts with facilities. Her total roster includes roughly 80 caregivers, though not all are active at any given time, as some work intermittently or travel internationally.

real_qa.q: How did the Eaton Fire in January 2025 impact Rhea Cruz-Magpantay's 1Heart franchise business in Pasadena?
real_qa.r: The Eaton Fire on January 7, 2025 devastated Rhea's business, wiping out one entire city in her territory and destroying about five major referring facilities and senior care centers that she worked with. Many clients in the affected area either moved away or lost their homes. Despite this major setback, Rhea's agency has recovered and bounced back, finding new referral partners and converting clients in neighboring territories by the end of 2025.
real_qa.requete: Eaton Fire January 2025 impact 1Heart Caregiver Services

real_qa.q: What training and support does 1Heart Caregiver Services provide to new franchisees and caregivers?
real_qa.r: 1Heart offers a five-day new franchisee training program and hosts two to three annual summits and conferences via Zoom and webinars. For caregiver training, 1Heart Caregiver University provides baseline training slides that franchisees can customize. Rhea enhanced this by renting a monthly conference room at a local hotel starting in 2026 to conduct in-person trainings on the last Thursday of each month, which improved caregiver attendance and demonstrated the franchise's investment in employee development.
real_qa.requete: 1Heart Caregiver Services training franchisee caregiver university

guest.bio_context: Rhea Cruz-Magpantay is a licensed nurse in California who co-founded the 1Heart Caregiver Services franchise in Pasadena with her brother in September 2022. She discovered 1Heart through a serendipitous connection at LA Jobs, a jobs placement company founded by Belina (1Heart's founder), after her father was diagnosed with cancer and her family sought business opportunities to stay together. She transitioned from nursing to focus full-time on building her non-medical senior care agency, which now manages approximately 50 caregivers on active payroll serving 30 regular clients.

real_quote: With One Heart, you feel like you have a family. You have somebody to depend on because they experience your dilemma right now.
